verdict.rationale: First-party docs say an agent is an LLM configured with instructions and tools, and that any Python function becomes a tool with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation, which covers typed custom tools. Community users describe the SDK as much simpler than alternatives, and the docs stress a small set of primitives, which supports the "few lines" claim. Missing for 10: a documented minimal code example showing the actual line count, and independent hands-on corroboration of typed custom tool definition specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define an agent with typed custom tools in a few lines of code

citations.quote: Function tools: Turn any Python function into a tool with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation.
FunctionTool instances: wrap any Python function as a tool.
An agent is a large language model (LLM) configured with instructions, tools, and optional runtime behavior
Build text, sandbox, and voice agents with a small set of primitives.
OpenAI SDK is much simpler to use and understand than langchain etc.
